name: ethara-taskflow
description: Full-stack team task manager assessment for Ethara.AI.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.vercel:build: npm run db:deploy --workspace server && npm run build
scripts.railway:start: npm run db:deploy --workspace server && npm run start --workspace server
